# ModelFile

Namespace `Nfty.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Model`.

```csharp
public sealed record ModelFile
```

One file of a written model: its name (no folder — the caller chooses where it goes) and its complete bytes. The constructor retains the supplied mutable byte array; this record does not make an ownership snapshot.
